title: Bottom Navigation
description: The Bottom Navigation bar allows movement between primary destinations in an app.

blocks.text: Bottom navigation bars display three to five destinations at the bottom of a screen. Each destination is represented by an icon and an optional text label. When a bottom navigation icon is tapped, the user is taken to the top-level navigation destination associated with that icon.
When there are only **three** actions, display both icons and text labels at all times.

blocks.name: SimpleBottomNavigation

blocks.text: If there are **four** or **five** actions, display inactive views as icons only.

blocks.name: LabelBottomNavigation

blocks.text: This demo keeps bottom navigation fixed to the bottom, no matter the amount of content on-screen.

blocks.name: FixedBottomNavigation

blocks.text:
One frequent use case is to perform navigation on the client only, without an HTTP round-trip to the server.
The `BottomNavigationAction` component provides the `component` prop to handle this use case.
Here is a [more detailed guide](/material-ui/integrations/routing/).
